format: html
code-fold: true
---
```{r,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
#| echo: false
library(tidyverse)
library(openintro)

weekly_gas_prices <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2025/2025-07-01/weekly_gas_prices.csv')

weekly_gas <- weekly_gas_prices
```

## The Data
Retrieved from TidyTuesday:   
https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/tree/main/data/2025/2025-07-01

The data is originally from the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA), which publishes average retail gasoline and diesel prices weekly.

Prices over time basic comparison
```{r}
ggplot(weekly_gas, aes(x=date, y=price, color=fuel)) +
  geom_line() + 
  labs(title = "Fuel Price Overtime")
```

```{r}
ggplot(weekly_gas, aes(x=date, y=price, color=fuel)) +
  geom_line() + 
  facet_wrap(~fuel) + 
  labs(title = "Fuel Price Overtime by Fuel")
```

Prices by Fuel Type and Grade
```{r}
weekly_gas |> 
  filter(fuel == "gasoline") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=date, y=price, color=grade)) +
    geom_line() + 
    facet_wrap(~grade) + 
    labs(title = "Prices for Gasoline")
```

```{r}
weekly_gas|> 
  filter(fuel == "diesel") |> 
  ggplot( aes(x=date, y=price, color=grade)) +
    geom_line() + 
    facet_wrap(~grade) + 
    labs(title = "Prices for Diesel")
```

Prices by Formulation of Gasoline
```{r}
weekly_gas |> 
  filter(fuel == "gasoline") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=date, y=price, color=formulation)) +
    geom_line() + 
    facet_wrap(~grade) + 
    labs(
    title = "Prices by Formulation", x = "Date", y= "Price",  color = "Formulation" )
```

Volatility/Price distribution
```{r}
ggplot(weekly_gas, aes(x=price, color = fuel)) +
    geom_histogram() + 
    labs(title = "Distribution of Price Changes by Fuel")
```

```{r}
ggplot(weekly_gas, aes(x=price, color = grade)) +
    geom_boxplot() + 
    facet_wrap(~fuel) +
    labs(title = "Distribution of Price Changes by Grade")
```
